newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan can achieve 2.5 pct growth next year - EPA.
newsitem.headline: Japan can achieve 2.5 pct growth next year - EPA.

text.p: Japan will likely be able to achieve the government's 2.5 percent economic growth target next fiscal year if current economic conditions continue, Economic Planning Agency (EPA) Minister Taro Aso said on Monday.
Aso, told the lower house budget committee that Japan's economy since autumn had been firm, as seen in growing car sales and housing construction.
"Capital investment is also steady, and if the current situation continues the way it is, it will be possible to achieve the government's 2.5 percent growth target," Aso said.
